lead_headline: Restaurant tracker logs just 1 new lead today — Carmine's on McGregor Square closing after 5 years — as foreclosure watch flags two $15M Weld County filings for next round of auctions.

restaurant.blurb: 1 lead today — Closure: Carmine's on McGregor Square (Union Station) shuttered July 18 after 5-year run.

foreclosure.blurb: Two $15 million filings both scheduled for Weld County auctions — one yesterday (July 31), one today (August 7) — though both list only "FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY" addresses.

liquor.blurb: 1 application filed Wednesday — The Coastal Service seeks hotel/restaurant license for 8125 E Belleview Ave (status: pending). Delinquency wave hits 7 operators including The Delorean (Broadway), Old Santa Fe (11th Ave), Urban Cafe (Broadway), Necio Latin Eatery (Tejon), LIV Denver (Market St), Denver Wine Merchant (Fox St), and 3 Margaritas at Northfield. Four licenses cleared delinquency: 7-Eleven Colfax, Lost City (Ringsby), Holey Moley (18th St), Devil's Drink (Platte). Application pace slows to single-digit territory after Monday-Tuesday 19-permit burst.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Wednesday — fourth consecutive blank day extends August media blackout into unprecedented territory. Seven-day window remains frozen at 0 total mentions from 0 sources, down from prior week's 40. No Instagram citations, no local pickups, no trade coverage. If drought persists through Friday, full week will close with ~0-2 mentions maximum — would mark lowest weekly total since tracking began and represent 95%+ collapse from typical 60-80 weekly baseline. Current pace projects August opening week at catastrophic sub-5 mention range. Year-to-date 1,167 mentions from 111 sources now aging rapidly without fresh additions.

subscriptions.blurb: Net −1 yesterday (0 new, 1 canceled) — single cancellation with zero acquisitions pulls MTD back to +3 (+0.5/day), 90-day net sits at +94. Wednesday's goose egg on new subscribers follows Tuesday's +6 performance, illustrating ongoing volatility in daily acquisition patterns. Seven-day window now shows +9 net (29 new, 20 canceled) vs. prior week's +22 — deceleration driven by 43% drop in new subscriber volume (29 vs. 35) rather than increased churn. Recent 14-day pattern shows clustering: strong bursts (July 28: +9, July 31: +6, Aug 4: +3) offset by flat/negative days. Current +0.5/day MTD pace runs half speed vs. +1.0/day YTD baseline — August will need sustained daily +2-3 performance to match long-term trajectory.
